comment: Liquid Dynamics impactors: heavy blunt things that run into the dummy. Each travels level along its z (half_extents_m are x across, y up, z along its travel), held up by what carries it (a road, a chain, an arm), slowed only by what it hits and, from brake_delay_s after it first touches the dummy, by brake_ms2. centre_height_m is its centre above the floor; without it, it is aimed at the scene's target.

impactors.name: Sledgehammer
impactors.description: A 4.5 kg head on a long handle, swung overhead and brought round level.

provenance.shape: estimated: a 10 lb head, 70 mm across and 170 mm long
provenance.mass_kg: estimated: the 4.5 kg head and the part of the handle that moves with it
provenance.speed_ms: estimated: a full swing of a long-handled hammer, 10-15 m/s at the head
provenance.brake_ms2: gameplay: the swing ends within a few centimetres of the blow

impactors.name: Wrecking ball
impactors.description: A one-tonne steel ball at the bottom of its swing.

provenance.radius_m: published: a 1,000 kg solid steel sphere (7,850 kg/m3) is 0.62 m across
provenance.mass_kg: published: wrecking balls run from about 450 kg to over 5 t
provenance.speed_ms: estimated: let go 1.8 m above the bottom of its arc, sqrt(2 g h)
provenance.brake_ms2: estimated: rising on its chain past the bottom, about g sin(theta) over the first metre

impactors.name: Car at 50 km/h
impactors.description: A mid-size car's front end at the urban speed limit, braking hard once it has hit.

provenance.half_extents_m: estimated: 1.76 m wide; bumper from about 0.25 m, bonnet leading edge about 0.85 m (Euro NCAP pedestrian test zones put the bumper at 0.4-0.55 m and the bonnet leading edge at 0.65-0.9 m)
provenance.mass_kg: published: mid-size saloons weigh 1,300-1,500 kg at the kerb
provenance.brake_delay_s: estimated: the driver is already reacting
provenance.brake_ms2: published: emergency braking with ABS on dry asphalt, 0.7-0.9 g

impactors.name: Truck at 80 km/h
impactors.description: A flat-fronted 12 t box truck at highway speed.

provenance.half_extents_m: estimated: a cab-over front 2.5 m wide, from 0.4 m to 2.0 m above the road
provenance.mass_kg: estimated: a laden medium truck, 10-15 t
provenance.brake_ms2: published: laden trucks stop at about 0.5 g
